description: This file defines an interface class IIpcFactory for creating IPC server components related to media services in the Rialto project. It declares factory methods for creating application management and session management servers, referencing various service interfaces.

classes.name: IIpcFactory
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods to create IPC server components for media services.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IApplicationManagementServer, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionManagementServer, given playback, cdm, and control services.
